summary: Compliance audit cycle completed. All 12 existing platform tests pass. New regulatory findings (NBR 5419:2026, NBR 17193:2025, NT 44/2025, NBR 16690/NBR 5410 revisions, STJ AREsp 3.001.677) integrated into platform checklist templates.

nbr_17193_2025.scope: SFV ≤1500V DC / ≤1000V AC, segurança contra incêndio

nt_44_2025_cbmgo.type1_requirements: AFPE, RSD, GFCI mandatory for Type 1 systems

nbr_5410_revisao.proposals: AFDD residential mandatory, stricter breaker/joule curves, harmonization with NBR 5419

stj_aresp_3_001_677.principle: Fire from electrical short-circuit with incandescent particles on stored solids. Absence of sprinklers + poor breaker maintenance = NOT fortuito. Liability applies under Art. 1.348 V CC/2002.
